name: ANAC open data - RAB aircraft registry (dados_aeronaves.csv)
tier_rationale: Federal civil-aviation regulator publishing the Registro Aeronautico Brasileiro as open data (government body, A8 trusted); P248 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: The regulator's own daily extract of the aircraft register (marks, models, owners/operators, status, liens).

rab.title: ANAC RAB aircraft registry daily CSV (dados_aeronaves.csv), matched locally

terms.quote: Opt-in (default_enabled=False). Output: mark, model, owner/operator company and registration status.

rab.notes: Quote: binding council text (P248 cond 4); research C0568 terms 'Open government data (ANAC)' (verified_live 206, 2026-11-26; full file 24.4 MB with ETag and a daily Last-Modified). One dataset download per day through `v3lum data update anac_rab_dados_aeronaves.csv` (a 24 MB file is never fetched during a scan; timeout 240 s: about 0.8 MB/s from the prep egress). P248 cond 2: natural-person owners and operators (masked CPFs, 'Indisponivel', short codes) are dropped when the copy is parsed; only companies identified by a CNPJ are matched or shown. Used by anac_rab.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-2 (P248 anac_rab). Dataset download only (disclosure 'none' module). No quota block. .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
